title: Jiffy Flatbread
description: Quick, savoury unleavened flatbreads made from white spelt flour, bicarbonate of soda and egg whites. Cooked in a hot griddle pan in minutes.

ingredients.text: 300g white spelt flour, plus extra for dusting

steps: Sift the flour and bicarbonate of soda into a bowl. Whisk the egg whites with a fork and add to the flour. Mix to a soft dough and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Turn out on to a floured surface, split into 8 pieces and roll each into a thin flatbread.
Place each on a square of greaseproof paper and stack.
Heat a griddle pan over high heat until a drop of water sizzles. Wipe dry.
Cook the flatbreads one at a time for 3–4 minutes each side until hard with dark scorch marks. Serve hot.
notes: Makes 8 flatbreads. Spelt gives a sweeter, nuttier flavour than plain flour.
